rule: Combined GC is the one compression product. TRUE 8B and Gate are stacks inside it, not storefronts. First 100 GB free on the Suite meter. Commercial GC Year is $490 (half the retired TRU8 Year $990). GC + Chamber Year stays $990 on the existing Stripe link. Lab Pass Year unlocks Chamber + Combined GC + TruGame. Suite stays a meter. SiOS is not a SKU. Rent desk retired. Do not claim top-3 general compressor. Do not sell retired $1900/$950/$12.50 links.
